name: My project made me $18,000 in 7 months
description: Solo developer shares how their side project generated $18,000 in revenue over 7 months (~$2,571/mo avg). Detailed breakdown of pricing strategy, launch tactics, and retention. Product is a developer-focused SaaS tool.

name: I built a tool that hit $516 MRR with no ads
description: Indie hacker built a SaaS tool that reached $516 MRR with zero advertising spend. Pure organic growth through product quality and word of mouth. Built for a niche audience with real pain point.

name: Show HN: Jynx — matchmaking app to find gaming teammates
description: Newly launched matchmaking app for finding gaming teammates. Fresh Show HN with early traction. Potential for premium subscription features.

name: CursorRules — AI编程规则管理工具（中国本地化版）
description: 管理 AI 编程助手规则文件的工具，支持团队共享和版本管理。国外付费订阅制已稳定盈利，MRR约$2,000。中国开发者可本地化+汉化版切入，市场空白。兼容 Cursor/Windsurf/Cline 等主流 AI IDE。

name: 独立开发者出海 — AI工具站群模式
description: 即刻上多位独立开发者分享通过AI工具站群（SEO+AI内容生成）实现月入$1K-$5K的模式。低成本建站，靠SEO流量变现，高可复制性。代表性案例包括AI图片工具站、PDF转换站等。

name: V2EX 独立开发者产品合集 — Notion模板/Figma UI Kit
description: V2EX 创造节点上多位开发者靠Notion模板、Figma UI Kit、代码模板实现月收入¥3,000-¥20,000（约$400-$2,700）。数字产品零边际成本，一次制作反复售卖。

name: 日本語AI文章校正SaaS — Shimeji（しめじ）
description: 日本語特化のAI文章校正ツール。Zennで話題の個人開発SaaS。月額980円〜、ビジネス文書の校正に特化。ChatGPT API活用のAIラッパー型。月収約30万円（≈$2,000-$3,000 MRR）で安定収益。

name: 日本の個人開発アプリ収益化事例集（Note.com）
description: Note.com上で個人開発アプリの収益公開が増加中。月収5-30万円（≈$300-$2,000 MRR）のアプリ開発者が複数。サブスクリプションモデル主流。具体的には習慣化アプリ、語学学習、家計簿など。

name: 即刻独立开发者热门产品合集 — 知识管理+AI工具
description: 即刻「独立开发者」圈子三大热门：1) Notion风格个人知识管理工具 月付$9.9/MRR约$2,000 2) AI壁纸生成器 单次付费$2.99/月收入约$800 3) Chrome书签管理插件 订阅$4.99/月/MRR约$1,200。三个产品均已盈利。

name: PushlapGrowth — Rewardful alternative with lifetime license
description: Affiliate marketing and referral tracking platform for SaaS companies. Lifetime license pricing as alternative to monthly subscriptions. Targets indie SaaS founders preferring one-time payments over recurring costs.

name: Warblize — AI Audiobook Narrator
description: AI-powered audiobook narration service converting text to natural-sounding audiobooks. Targets authors, publishers, and content creators expanding into audio. Show HN launch with positive feedback.

name: Agent-estimate — AI agent coding task time estimator
description: Developer tool estimating how long coding tasks take for AI agents (Codex, Claude Code). Addresses the gap between AI speed and traditional estimation methods. Open source with potential for paid tier.

name: ScreenSmooth — Chrome extension for screen recordings
description: Browser-based screen recording Chrome extension with premium features. Monetized via subscription for advanced editing and export options. Indie hacker project with growing MRR.

name: Pure Metrics — Privacy-first web analytics, <1KB script
description: Privacy-first web analytics with <1KB tracking script. Paid subscription model, GDPR-compliant, no cookies needed. Alternative to Google Analytics for privacy-conscious sites.

name: ChurnBurner — Predicts SaaS churn from Stripe data
description: Predicts SaaS churn using Stripe data and behavioral signals. Monetized churn prediction tool for SaaS companies wanting to reduce customer loss.

name: Resonly — Prioritize feature requests by revenue impact
description: SaaS tool that helps product teams prioritize feature requests based on revenue impact. Connects to Stripe to show which features drive MRR growth.

name: paykit — The billing framework for TypeScript
description: Billing framework for TypeScript that handles Stripe, webhooks, and usage state. Has Pro/Enterprise pricing tiers — monetized open source project with 951 stars.

name: dario — Claude Pro/Max subscription in any AI tool
description: Claude Pro/Max subscription proxy that works in any AI tool — Cursor, Cline, Aider, Agent SDK. Subscription pricing instead of per-token billing. Monetized AI proxy service with 223 stars.

name: Softalon — All-in-one salon booking and scheduling software
description: Complete salon booking and scheduling software. Covers appointments, staff management, and client communications. Niche vertical SaaS with recurring subscription revenue model.

name: Airstrip — SaaS runway forecasting that models MRR lag
description: Financial planning tool for SaaS startups that models MRR lag, churn, and runway. Helps founders understand cash flow dynamics specific to subscription businesses.

name: KitoAI — AI agent that predicts and prevents SaaS churn in real time
description: AI-powered churn prediction and prevention for SaaS businesses. Uses machine learning to identify at-risk customers and suggests intervention strategies in real time.

name: SaaS Marketing Kit — $300 Claude Code Credit included
description: Marketing kit for SaaS founders including launch templates, SEO guides, and $300 Claude Code credit for AI-assisted marketing. Paid product targeting indie developers launching new products.

name: I analyzed why 34 products that hit #1 on PH never made $1k MRR
description: Analysis of 34 Product Hunt #1 products showing they failed to reach $1K MRR. Key lesson: PH upvotes ≠ paying customers. B2C viral traffic rarely converts to B2B SaaS revenue. Essential read for indie hackers.

name: You're overcomplicating it — Got SaaS to $3.6K MRR solving a boring problem
description: Founder reached $3,600 MRR by solving a boring but real problem. Lesson: stop chasing shiny AI trends, find mundane problems people actually pay to solve. B2B SaaS in unsexy industry.

name: Open-source .docx editor library — build document apps
description: Open-source JavaScript library for building document editing apps (.docx format). Monetization potential through cloud hosting, enterprise features, or premium templates. Hot in the document automation space.
